annotations.title: Rename, colour, move, merge, archive or delete categories

description: Change categories that exist — **a list of edits in one call**. Per entry: `name`, `parent_id` (any category of its kind with room — three levels at most — or null for the top level), `move` (up or down), `archived`, `monthly_target` (major units, null clears — the category’s Plan bucket in the plan in use: one figure, shared with Plan), `color` (category-1 … category-11, null for automatic), `icon`, or, alone in the entry, `merge_into` (a category id) or `delete: true` — with `move_to` (a category id of the same kind) when rows, rules, subcategories, Plan buckets, bills, debts or goals still use it. This is the Categories screen’s rename, colour, move, merge, archive and delete, and its Plan bucket. A heading (Living, Income…) is a top-level category, renamed and moved like any other. Adding categories is `create_category`. **Dry-runs by default**: it says what each entry would do and which it refuses (a taken name, a fourth level, a delete with nowhere to move what uses it) and writes nothing until you call again with `commit: true`. The document is copied to a timestamped .bak first. Ids come from `category_tree`.

commit.description: Default false. False previews and writes nothing; true makes the changes.

edits.description: One entry per category. Up to 100 in a call.

archived.description: True archives, false brings it back.

color.description: One of category-1, category-2, category-3, category-4, category-5, category-6, category-7, category-8, category-9, category-10, category-11, or null for automatic.

delete.description: Delete the category. Alone in the entry, or with `move_to` when something still uses it.

icon.description: An emoji, or null to clear.

merge_into.description: Merge this category into another: its rows, rules and subcategories move. Alone in the entry.

monthly_target.description: The category’s Plan bucket, each month, in the document’s currency, major units (Home shows spending against it); with no plan yet it makes the default one. Null clears.

move.description: One place up or down among its siblings, in the order the screen lists them.

move_to.description: With `delete`: the category its rows, rules, subcategories, Plan buckets, bills, debts and goals move to first. Same kind; with room for its subcategories.

name.description: A new name. Another category’s name is refused.

parent_id.description: Move under this category (its subcategories come along), or null for the top level.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.
